headline: 🛡️ Check Point VPN pre-auth RCEs on NCSC imminent-exploit warning, 🤖 AI agents mass-exploit PaperCut across 395 orgs, 🌙 BlueMoon kit tied to four China-aligned groups, 🪪 IDScan breach exposes 150M+ licenses, ⚠️ LiteLLM gateways accept default admin key, 🎭 Revolut breach via fake police data requests
summary: The Dutch NCSC's imminent-exploitation warning for two CVSS 9.8 pre-auth Check Point VPN RCEs leads a day whose other defining threads are GreyNoise's report of AI agents compromising 395 organizations through PaperCut and Proofpoint naming the BlueMoon exploit kit shared by four espionage groups.
